meta.title: Anime Vanguards familiars data

sources.label: Anime Vanguards Wiki - Familiars
sources.usage: Primary familiar list, rarity, effect, obtainment, corruption/reroll rules, and image candidates.

meta.notes: Rows follow the parent-approved 30-familiar scope from the Fandom Familiars page. The source has an empty Limited tab, so no Limited section is included. Regular familiar stats are represented as ranges/summaries because the source describes random rolls and corruption-adjusted ranges rather than fixed values.

imageCoverage.source: Anime Vanguards Fandom Familiars page file redirects and MediaWiki imageinfo URLs

imageNotes: Image pass downloaded one clean familiar icon per approved row from the Fandom Familiars page file list.
Menu screenshots, unit portraits, effect icons, and generic item icons were excluded by using each row rawImageName from the approved Familiars dataset.

items.name: Gujo's Glasses
items.obtainment: Events; later permanent method noted by source
items.mainEffect: Void follow-up when an enemy leaves range, a large damage boost, and a longer Void damage window.
items.statRangeSummary: Damage +250%
items.corruptionNotes: Cannot be corrupted.
items.cardSummary: A Vanguard Familiar for Gujo (Infinity) that turns Void into a stronger follow-up and damage-window tool.

items.name: Sukono's Finger
items.obtainment: Events; later permanent method noted by source
items.elementBuffs: Curse allies +30% damage
items.mainEffect: Applies Cleaved, buffs Curse units, increases damage and range, and adds an Attack 2 follow-up.
items.statRangeSummary: Damage +200%; range +30%
items.corruptionNotes: Cannot be corrupted.
items.cardSummary: A Vanguard Familiar for Sukono built around Cleaved application, Curse team support, and a strong damage/range boost.

items.name: Tengon's Smokebomb
items.obtainment: Events; later permanent method noted by source
items.elementBuffs: Adds Fire element; Fire and Blast allies +30% damage
items.mainEffect: Guarantees critical hits against debuffed enemies, buffs critical damage, supports Fire/Blast allies, and inflicts Scorched.
items.statRangeSummary: Damage +275%; crit damage +30% after attacking debuffed enemies
items.corruptionNotes: Cannot be corrupted.
items.cardSummary: A Vanguard Familiar for Tengon (Flashiness) that rewards debuff setups with guaranteed crits and Fire/Blast support.

items.name: Key of Babylon
items.obtainment: Events; later permanent method noted by source
items.mainEffect: Adds damage, Slow or Stun control by enemy type, and NP stack behavior for Enuma Eilish.
items.statRangeSummary: Damage +125%; NP stacks up to 30
items.corruptionNotes: Cannot be corrupted.
items.cardSummary: A Vanguard Familiar for Gilgamesh (King of Heroes) focused on boss/control utility and NP-stack attacks.

items.name: Secluded Kunai
items.obtainment: Events; later permanent method noted by source
items.mainEffect: Makes the next Obita placement free after selling, burns enemies on placement, and adds a large damage/range boost.
items.statRangeSummary: Damage +650%; range +20%
items.corruptionNotes: Cannot be corrupted.
items.cardSummary: A Vanguard Familiar for Obita (Awakened) that combines placement burn, sell-replacement utility, and a large damage boost.

items.name: American Flag
items.obtainment: Events; later permanent method noted by source
items.mainEffect: Greatly increases damage, improves clone behavior, and lets selling swap with a nearby active clone.
items.statRangeSummary: Damage +700%
items.corruptionNotes: Cannot be corrupted.
items.cardSummary: A Vanguard Familiar for Valentine (Love Train) that turns clone play into stronger damage and positioning utility.

items.name: Eyes of Despair
items.obtainment: Events; later permanent method noted by source
items.elementBuffs: Spark synergy through lightning arc
items.mainEffect: Adds damage, creates a lightning arc to a Spark unit in range, and performs a one-time attack on placement.
items.statRangeSummary: Damage +400%; lightning arc deals 40% damage per second
items.corruptionNotes: Cannot be corrupted.
items.cardSummary: A Vanguard Familiar for Sosuke (Storm) that adds Spark-linked damage and an opening placement attack.

items.name: Vampire's Seal
items.obtainment: Events; later permanent method noted by source
items.mainEffect: Improves summon HP, marks enemies hit by summons, turns marked deaths into Thralls, and strengthens Wounded/Bleed control.
items.statRangeSummary: Damage +1200%; summon HP doubled
items.corruptionNotes: Cannot be corrupted.
items.cardSummary: A Vanguard Familiar for Alocard (Vampire King) that heavily amplifies summon and wound-based gameplay.

items.name: The Doctor
items.obtainment: HAPPY Factory Raid Act 1 at 2%; Act 2 at 50%
items.mainEffect: A Doctor's Touch changes by corruption: Nullify, Rupture, price decrease, or extra hits to Shielded enemies.
items.statRangeSummary: Damage +10% to +20%; range +10% to +20%; corruption ranges can be higher.
items.corruptionNotes: Corruption changes the special effect and can raise stat bounds.
items.cardSummary: A Secret raid familiar with corruption-dependent utility and damage/range stat rolls.

items.name: Chili
items.obtainment: Frozen Volcano Dungeon Shop
items.elementBuffs: Random Unbound, Spark, or Blast damage +2% to +5%
items.mainEffect: Reliable Friend increases critical damage when the equipped unit crits.
items.statRangeSummary: Critical damage +0% to +40%; corruption range listed up to +60%.
items.corruptionNotes: Corruption can increase the critical damage range.
items.cardSummary: A Mythic shop familiar for crit-focused units, with a random Unbound/Spark/Blast damage roll.

items.name: Birb
items.obtainment: Ruined City Raid Act 1 at 1%; Act 2 at 3%
items.elementBuffs: Random Water, Spark, or Blast damage +2% to +5%
items.mainEffect: Ventriloquism changes damage, critical damage, range, and critical chance.
items.statRangeSummary: Damage, critical damage, range, and critical chance can roll positive or negative values.
items.corruptionNotes: Multi-stat corruption rolls each stat separately, so perfect rolls are extremely rare.
items.cardSummary: A Secret raid familiar with volatile multi-stat rolls and Water/Spark/Blast element damage options.

items.name: Black Spirit
items.obtainment: Ruined City Raid Shop
items.elementBuffs: Random Blast, Spark, or Nature damage +2% to +5%
items.mainEffect: Dark Spirit increases meter generated by attacks that would generate meter.
items.statRangeSummary: Meter generation +0.1% to +100%; corruption range listed up to +150%.
items.corruptionNotes: Corruption can raise the meter-generation range.
items.cardSummary: A Mythic raid-shop familiar for meter-based units, with Blast/Spark/Nature damage roll support.

items.name: Belu
items.obtainment: Dungeon Shop
items.elementBuffs: Random Curse, Fire, or Unknown damage +2% to +5%
items.mainEffect: For the King consumes the five lowest-HP summons on hit to buff that attack's damage.
items.statRangeSummary: Summon-consumption attack buff +5% to +20%; corruption range listed up to +30%.
items.corruptionNotes: Corruption can raise the attack-buff range.
items.cardSummary: A Mythic dungeon-shop familiar for summon-heavy setups that trade weak summons for higher attack damage.

items.name: Gon
items.obtainment: Rift Shop
items.elementBuffs: Random Cosmic, Spark, or Nature damage +2% to +5%
items.mainEffect: Spirit Candy lets attacks ignore part of enemy damage reduction.
items.statRangeSummary: Ignores 10% to 50% damage reduction; corruption range listed up to 75%.
items.corruptionNotes: Corruption can increase the damage-reduction ignore range.
items.cardSummary: A Rift Shop familiar that helps units punch through damage reduction with Cosmic/Spark/Nature roll support.

items.name: Pachiru
items.obtainment: Rift Shop
items.elementBuffs: Random Cosmic, Fire, or Unbound damage +2% to +5%
items.mainEffect: Thirst for Battle increases damage whenever the equipped unit is stunned, up to a cap.
items.statRangeSummary: Damage +1% to +10% per stun, up to +30%; corruption range listed up to +45%.
items.corruptionNotes: Corruption can raise the stun-scaling damage cap.
items.cardSummary: A Rift Shop familiar for units that get stunned or self-stun, scaling damage during those windows.

items.name: Foo
items.obtainment: Rift Shop
items.elementBuffs: Random Curse, Holy, or Passion damage +2% to +5%
items.mainEffect: Primate Murder buffs allies when the equipped unit applies an effect on them.
items.statRangeSummary: Ally damage buff +2% to +10%; corruption range listed up to +15%.
items.corruptionNotes: Corruption can raise the ally-buff range.
items.cardSummary: A Rift Shop familiar for support units that apply ally effects and can turn those effects into damage buffs.

items.name: Bobodi
items.obtainment: Land of The Gods Legend Stage Act 3 at 5%
items.elementBuffs: Random Cosmic, Blast, or Holy damage +2% to +5%
items.mainEffect: Manipulating Evil makes kills count as extra kills for on-kill effects, excluding meter effects.
items.statRangeSummary: Kills count as 0 to 2 extra kills; corruption range listed up to 3.
items.corruptionNotes: Corruption can raise the on-kill count range.
items.cardSummary: A Legend Stage familiar for on-kill units, helping kill-count effects trigger faster.

items.name: Pupper
items.obtainment: Land of The Gods Legend Stage Act 3 at 5%
items.elementBuffs: Random Nature, Blast, or Holy damage +2% to +5%
items.mainEffect: Man's Best Friend increases crit rate and crit damage; the buff is doubled for Dragon Sphere units.
items.statRangeSummary: Crit rate +1% to +5%; crit damage +2.5% to +10%; corruption ranges are higher.
items.corruptionNotes: Corruption can raise crit-rate and crit-damage ranges.
items.cardSummary: A Legend Stage familiar for crit builds, especially Dragon Sphere units that double its crit buff.

items.name: Ro Jer
items.obtainment: Shining Castle Legend Stage Act 3 at 5%; Act 4 at 10%
items.elementBuffs: Random Nature, Unbound, or Spark damage +2% to +5%
items.mainEffect: Warrior's Spirit permanently reduces HP regeneration on enemies hit by the equipped unit.
items.statRangeSummary: HP regeneration reduction +1% to +50%; corruption range listed up to +75%.
items.corruptionNotes: Corruption can raise the regeneration-reduction range.
items.cardSummary: A Legend Stage familiar for anti-regeneration utility with Nature/Unbound/Spark damage roll support.

items.name: Nose
items.obtainment: Hill of Swords Story Stages Acts 1-6 at 10%
items.elementBuffs: Random Unbound, Cosmic, or Nature damage +2% to +5%
items.mainEffect: Light in the Dark stuns the equipped unit when it attacks, then increases damage during the stun window.
items.statRangeSummary: Damage +0% to +35% during self-stun window; corruption range listed up to +52.5%.
items.corruptionNotes: Corruption can raise the self-stun damage range.
items.cardSummary: A Story Stage familiar built around self-stun damage windows and Unbound/Cosmic/Nature rolls.

items.name: Silly Fairy
items.obtainment: Burning Spirit Tree Legend Stages Acts 1-3 at 1%; Act 4 at 5%
items.elementBuffs: Random Curse, Cosmic, or Nature damage +2% to +5%
items.mainEffect: Whimsical Being decreases upgrade cost for every placement of the equipped unit.
items.statRangeSummary: Upgrade cost reduction +0% to +5% per placement; corruption range listed up to +7.5%.
items.corruptionNotes: Corruption can raise the upgrade-cost reduction range.
items.cardSummary: A Secret Legend Stage familiar that helps reduce upgrade costs on repeated placements.

items.name: Doggo
items.obtainment: Gift Box 1 at 10%; Update 3.0 Winter Event / Legacy Event Shop
items.elementBuffs: Random Fire, Spark, or Water damage +0.5% to +2%
items.mainEffect: Avatar increases damage for each unique element on the team.
items.statRangeSummary: Damage +0.1% to +2% per unique team element; corruption range listed up to +3%.
items.corruptionNotes: Corruption can raise the team-element damage range.
items.cardSummary: An Exclusive familiar that rewards teams with varied elements and adds Fire/Spark/Water damage rolls.

items.name: Sebamon
items.obtainment: Gift Box 2 at 10%; Update 3.0 Winter Event / Legacy Event Shop
items.elementBuffs: Random Fire, Spark, or Blast damage +0.5% to +2%
items.mainEffect: Unified increases damage for every matching team element shared with the equipped unit.
items.statRangeSummary: Damage +0.5% to +2% per matching element; corruption range listed up to +3%.
items.corruptionNotes: Corruption can raise the matching-element damage range.
items.cardSummary: An Exclusive familiar for teams stacked around the equipped unit's element.

items.name: Padoru
items.obtainment: Gift Box 3 at 10%; Update 3.0 Winter Event / Legacy Event Shop
items.elementBuffs: Random Holy, Cosmic, or Passion damage +0.5% to +2%
items.mainEffect: Padoru periodically gives a random present: a short damage/range buff, yen, or a one-time upgrade-cost decrease.
items.statRangeSummary: Present every 10 to 60 seconds; corruption can make the interval shorter.
items.corruptionNotes: For Padoru's gift interval, a lower corruption roll can be better.
items.cardSummary: An Exclusive utility familiar that periodically grants a random support present.

items.name: Strange Cat
items.obtainment: Wooden Chest at 10%; Update 6.5 Spring Event / Legacy Event Shop
items.elementBuffs: Random damage buff from many listed elements, +2% to +5%
items.mainEffect: Luck of the Gods increases damage and range and has special multi-corruption behavior.
items.statRangeSummary: Damage +0% to +7%; range +0% to +3.5%; corruption ranges are higher.
items.corruptionNotes: Can be corrupted up to five times, but a Corruption II roll stops further corruption and is not applied.
items.cardSummary: An Exclusive familiar with broad element-roll coverage and unusual multi-corruption rules.

items.name: Summer Ham
items.obtainment: Iced Box at 10%; Update 7.5 Summer Event / Legacy Event Shop
items.elementBuffs: Random Fire, Water, or Holy damage +2% to +5%
items.mainEffect: Durable Pig increases damage and damage-over-time output per missing life stock.
items.statRangeSummary: Damage and DoT damage +1% to +10% per missing life stock; corruption range listed up to +15%.
items.corruptionNotes: Corruption can raise the missing-life-stock damage range.
items.cardSummary: An Exclusive familiar for life-stock builds and damage-over-time setups.

items.name: Yuruzuu
items.obtainment: Anniversary Shop
items.elementBuffs: Random Element damage +5% to +10%
items.mainEffect: Yuruzuu increases money generated by farms.
items.statRangeSummary: Farm money +2% to +10%; corruption range listed up to +15%.
items.corruptionNotes: Corruption can raise the farm-money range.
items.cardSummary: An unobtainable Exclusive familiar for farm-income builds with a strong random element damage roll.

items.name: Turbo Granny
items.obtainment: Any boss in Infinite mode of Occult Hunt at 1%
items.elementBuffs: Random Curse, Nature, or Unbound damage +0.5% to +5%
items.mainEffect: Beckoning Cat increases critical chance and critical damage with each attack until a critical hit lands.
items.statRangeSummary: Critical chance +10%; critical damage +0.5% to +3%; corruption ranges are higher.
items.corruptionNotes: Corruption can raise critical chance and critical damage ranges.
items.cardSummary: An unobtainable Exclusive familiar that ramps crit pressure until the equipped unit lands a critical hit.

items.name: Alottavisits
items.obtainment: Mailbox reward during the 1 billion visits period before the message was deleted
items.elementBuffs: Random listed element or Unknown damage +2% to +5%
items.mainEffect: 1,000,000,000 Visits increases damage, lowers SPA, and increases range.
items.statRangeSummary: Damage +10%; SPA -5%; range +10%; corruption ranges differ by stat.
items.corruptionNotes: Corruption can adjust the damage, SPA, and range values.
items.cardSummary: An unobtainable milestone familiar with damage, SPA, range, and broad element-roll benefits.

items.name: Spirit Dispenser
items.obtainment: Event
items.elementBuffs: Random Cosmic, Unknown, or Blast damage +2% to +5%
items.mainEffect: Spirit Boost increases damage for 40 seconds when the equipped unit activates an active ability.
items.statRangeSummary: Active-triggered damage +5% to +30%; corruption range listed up to +45%.
items.corruptionNotes: Corruption can raise the active-triggered damage range.
items.cardSummary: An unobtainable Exclusive familiar that turns active ability use into a temporary damage boost.
